results.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
results.overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

results.title: Avengers: Doomsday
results.overview: Beloved heroes from three distinct universes are set on a deadly collision course and face an existential threat unlike anything they've ever encountered.

results.title: OK! Madam: Bon Voyage
results.overview: A family fresh off a daring high-altitude plane rescue gets mysteriously invited onto a luxury cruise, only to find themselves trapped in a wild, unpredictable new crisis.

results.title: The End of Oak Street
results.overview: After a mysterious cosmic event rips Oak Street from suburbia and transports their neighborhood to someplace unknown, the Platt family soon discovers that their very survival depends on them sticking together as they navigate their now unrecognizable surroundings.

results.title: Clayface
results.overview: Follow the terrifying descent into hell of a promising Hollywood actor who has become a monster driven by revenge, exploring the loss of identity and humanity, the ravages of toxic love and the dark side of scientific ambition.

results.title: Other Mommy
results.overview: A young girl, Bela, forms a relationship with a sinister entity in her home who looks uncannily like her own mother.

results.title: Ramayana
results.overview: An ancient epic follows a young prince and princess whose marriage and subsequent exile mark the beginning of a legendary journey. Their story of love, duty and destiny sets the stage for greater challenges ahead.

results.title: Fast Forever
results.overview: The eleventh and final installment in The Fast Saga. Plot TBA.

results.title: Resident Evil
results.overview: Bryan, a medical courier, is in the process of making a delivery when a sudden outbreak occurs, forcing him to fight for survival.

results.title: Dune: Part Three
results.overview: As Emperor, Paul Atreides grapples with the consequences of his rise to power as political conspiracies and a galaxy-spanning holy war threaten the future he alone can foresee.

results.title: Avengers: Secret Wars
results.overview: An upcoming film in Phase Six of the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) and the finale of The Multiverse Saga. Plot TBA.

results.title: From the Ashes
results.overview: Jailed for her husband's crime, a woman discovers that her only way out is to solve riddles from her mysterious past.

results.title: Digger
results.overview: The most powerful man in the world embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity's savior before the disaster he's unleashed destroys everything.

results.title: Ebenezer
results.overview: Tale of an elderly miser, Ebenezer Scrooge, who embarks on a supernatural journey after being visited by the ghost of his former business partner and the Spirits of Christmas Past, Present, and Yet to Come, forcing him to confront his past and fight for a second chance at happiness.

results.title: Ice Cream Man
results.overview: An idyllic summer town descends into madness when an ice cream man serves kids sweet delights with horrifying results.

results.title: Shrek 5
results.overview: Shrek and Donkey team up for another whirlwind, big-city adventure.

results.title: Forgotten Island
results.overview: While celebrating their last night together, high school graduates and best friends Jo and Raissa stumble upon a mysterious portal that transports them to the fantastical island of Nakali. When they discover that the memories of their entire friendship are the price for returning home, Jo and Raissa will race to find a way to leave the island before they forget each other forever.

results.title: Mutiny
results.overview: After witnessing his billionaire boss' murder and being framed for the crime, Cole Reed boards a cargo ship on a one-man crusade to avenge his boss' death only to discover an international conspiracy.

results.title: Toxic
results.overview: As Portuguese rule crumbles in Goa, Raya rises through betrayal and bloodshed to claim the city’s underworld, only to learn that power always demands a price.

results.title: Fall 2: Deadpoint
results.overview: On a perilous climb across Thailand's Mount Kwan, two climbers become trapped thousands of feet above the ground, where vertigo-inducing heights, sheer exposure, and impossible odds turn every moment into a fight for survival.
